$description: Bloom design tokens, resolved. W3C Design Tokens Community Group format. SHAPE CONTRACT (consumers codegen against this — additions are additive, existing paths do not move): color.<preset>.<scheme>.<token> — <preset> is a Bloom AppColorName, <scheme> is "light" or "dark", and <token> is the CSS custom property Bloom writes on the document root with its leading "--" removed, so color.oxy.dark.card carries the value of --card under the oxy preset in dark. Every colour $value is an sRGB hex string: "#rrggbb", or "#rrggbbaa" when the token carries alpha (the -subtle family does). spacing/radius/borderWidth are DTCG dimensions with a px unit in the string. typography.<role> is a group of fontSize (dimension), lineHeight (dimension) and fontWeight (number); font FAMILIES are deliberately absent — they resolve to CSS variables a non-browser consumer cannot use. Shadows are absent for the same reason: Bloom ships them as a platform-forked style object (bloomShadowStyle), not as a value. AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generate-design-tokens-json.ts from Bloom’s colour engine — do not edit.

color.$description: One group per Bloom colour preset, each with a light and a dark scheme. Token names match the CSS custom properties without the leading "--".

spacing.$description: The Oxy spacing scale. Same keys as the Tailwind/NativeWind utilities (p-space-8, gap-space-20, px-screen-margin).

radius.$description: The corner-radius scale. Same keys as the rounded-radius-* utilities; radius-max is the pill/circle sentinel.

borderWidth.$description: Border widths. hairline is the 0.5px rule that pairs with the border-image colour role.

typography.$description: One group per type role. Sizes and line-heights are px dimensions; weights are DTCG numeric font weights.
